description: Migrates a Redis instance between modes (standalone to cluster) or performs an in-place version upgrade. Takes an RDB snapshot before any changes. Full rollback via RDB restore.

source_version.label: Source Version
source_version.description: Current Redis version (e.g. 6.2). Required for version_upgrade.

cluster_nodes.label: Cluster Nodes
cluster_nodes.description: List of {host, port} for cluster nodes (standalone_to_cluster only)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight checks only — no changes applied

rollback.description: RDB snapshot restore. For version_upgrade: reinstall previous binary and restore RDB. For standalone_to_cluster: cluster reset and RDB restore to standalone mode.
